errors.heading: If the form shows an error
errors.body: A message appears under the answer that needs changing, and the same message is listed at the top of the page. Change the answer and press Continue.

documents.heading: Documents we may ask for
documents.body: Proof of income, such as your 3 most recent payslips, and photo ID. We ask for them after you apply.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.body: Email help@rentready.example. We answer within one working day.
